exercise.name: Barbell Standing Wide Grip Biceps Curl

reference.title: Barbell Standing Wide Grip Biceps Curl
reference.listing: Video (title from the listing URL; the page could not be read from this environment, gymvisual.com is blocked by the proxy, so the movement is taken from the exercise name and standard coaching)

breathing.pattern: Breathe out as the bar comes up, in as it lowers.
breathing.cadence: About 1.2 s up, 0.3 s squeeze, 2.4 s down

prescription.tempo: 1 s up, short squeeze, 2-3 s down
prescription.load: Barbell load is user-chosen: a little lighter than a shoulder-width curl; no swing, about 2 reps in reserve.
prescription.progression: Add a rep per set, then 1-2.5 kg.

cues.text: Stand tall, underhand grip a few inches wider than the shoulders, bar resting on the thighs, elbows at the sides.
Curl the bar up in an arc, elbows pinned to the sides.
Squeeze the biceps at the top without letting the elbows drift forward.
Arms long, stay tall, start the next rep without a swing.

mistakes.fix: Stay tall with the glutes squeezed; lighten the bar.
Keep the elbows at the sides; the hands are wider than the elbows.
Straighten the arms fully each rep.
Keep the wrists straight; shorten the grip a little if they hurt.

kinematics.norm: Full range from a straight arm to about 130-145 degrees (clinical opinion)

kinematics.measure: Forearm rotation (wrist pron channel, 0 = palm up/forward, 90 = thumb up)
kinematics.norm: Palms up the whole rep with a straight bar (clinical opinion)

kinematics.measure: Upper arm from the trunk line (sagittal)
kinematics.norm: Elbows at the sides; the hands sit wider than the elbows (clinical opinion)
Bar close to the body but not dragging (clinical opinion)
About 1 s up and 2-3 s down (clinical opinion)

cautions: Wide grips put more twist on the wrists and elbows; use a grip that feels comfortable.
Elbow pain: narrow the grip or use an EZ bar or dumbbells.
Stop if sharp pain, numbness, tingling or giving-way occurs.
Muscle glow colours and activation curves are illustrative, not measured EMG.

muscleNotes.biceps_r: Bends the elbows against the bar; the wide grip turns the forearms out and is often felt more in the short (inner) head.
muscleNotes.biceps_l: Bends the elbows against the bar; the wide grip turns the forearms out and is often felt more in the short (inner) head.
muscleNotes.forearm_flexors_r: Hold the bar and help bend the elbows.
muscleNotes.forearm_flexors_l: Hold the bar and help bend the elbows.
muscleNotes.ant_deltoid_r: Holds the upper arms still at the sides; it works more if the elbows drift forward.
muscleNotes.ant_deltoid_l: Holds the upper arms still at the sides; it works more if the elbows drift forward.
muscleNotes.core: Keeps the trunk still, no swing.
muscleNotes.upper_traps_r: Steady the shoulders; do not shrug.
muscleNotes.upper_traps_l: Steady the shoulders; do not shrug.
